messages:
rachel: Greenbridge finished onboarding today and sent a short list of pain points + feature asks. can we capture and route to product? pasting the highlights below.
jenny: thanks — quick summary from their doc: 1) per-route cost breakdown in console (they only see account-level spend) 2) embeddings tuning/relevance for short queries 3) ability to rollback model versions in Dedicated 4) more onboarding templates for prompt sets. they flagged 1 & 2 as high impact.
sam: can you paste any verbatim quotes or examples so we can estimate impact/frequency?
rachel: quotes from their email: "we're over-provisioning because we can't see per-route token spend" and "search results with embeddings are noisy for 1–3 word queries". they gave example query set — i'll share.
alisha: i can run a quick eval on their embedding set to quantify relevance drop. jenny — can you grant me access to their eval prompts + a sample of indexed vectors?
jenny: granting access now. doc + artifacts: https://redwood.internal/greenbridge/onboarding-feedback (internal link). sharing perms to alisha.
mike: infra note — exposing per-route token/costs is possible but needs attribution plumbing + sampling. ballpark: 1 engineer ~2 sprints (metrics + console UI). we can prototype a sampled endpoint sooner.
sam: priority raw vote from product side: per-route cost = P0, embeddings tuning = P1, rollback button = P2, onboarding templates = P3. need expected ROI numbers (savings or risk reduction) to push PR higher.
rachel: CS will collect customer-facing impact (dollars saved estimate, number of affected routes) and back the PR. also ask product: can we offer a temporary manual report for them while feature is built?
alisha: to get started, quick command to pull their embeddings sample: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood/v1/projects/greenbridge/embeddings?sample=1000" | jq '.'``` should give us vectors + metadata.
jenny: greenbridge also asked for a live onboarding refresher next week — i can schedule a 30m session.
sam: i'll create tickets and link to product board, tag with customer:greenbridge. created PRD stub and ticket RB-1234 (link: https://go/redwood/RB-1234).
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: staging build 2026-03-16_12:59 (for console prototype) — 1847654380
jenny: great. i'll follow up with Greenbridge on scheduling and send the prioritized ask list to #prod-requests.
rachel: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
